candidate.title: TATL-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned TATL-seq row depicts the cap-selective library preparation of translation-associated transcript leader sequencing, from the polysome input icon through adapter-flanked cDNA. This is one representative per-fraction route; the primary implementation prepares libraries independently from polysome-gradient fractions, including fractions with little or no ribosome association. TL-seq is the embedded cap-capture component, not an additional target workflow. Adjacent SMORE-Seq, TL-seq and RARseq rows and the right-hand nucleoside drawings are context, with no depicted material connection to this row. The primary paper resolves the extra early Reverse transcription caption as described in correction c01. The depicted 3′-adapter route is the TATL-seq implementation; the paper’s poly(A)-tailing alternative for initial TL-seq is outside this row.

states.label: Poly(A)-selected RNA from one polysome-gradient fraction
features: The source input icon is labelled Polysomes and shows multiple ribosomes on a transcript; the left descriptor shows a GPPP-capped RNA with a poly(A) end.
The primary paper clarifies that RNA is recovered from each fraction and poly(A) selected before fragmentation; downstream enzymatic reactions act on extracted RNA, not intact ribosome complexes.
Gradient-fraction identity is a sample association retained through the library; no molecular fraction barcode or physical pooling is depicted.

states.label: Adapter-flanked cDNA representing a captured transcript 5′ segment
features: Final cDNA is drawn green–blue–orange, replacing the purple RNA insert with a blue DNA carrier.
cDNA preserves the captured 5′-end sequence and adapter boundary. Sequencing such libraries supports transcript-start and leader-isoform annotation.

Across separately identified fraction libraries, relative abundance of the same leader isoform reports its sedimentation distribution and supports an inference about ribosome association and translational activity. It is not a direct protein-output or ribosome-position measurement.
No sequencing, PCR or computational-integration operations are drawn after this endpoint.

operations.label: Fragmentation and size selection
operations.description: Fragment the fraction-derived, poly(A)-selected RNA and retain a short-fragment population, including capped 5′ termini and other end classes. The Polysomes icon specifies biological provenance; paper-supported RNA recovery and poly(A) selection are input preparation, not additional depicted steps.
operations.mechanism: The primary implementation uses alkaline hydrolysis followed by gel selection of short RNA fragments.
operations.information_effect: Preserves the original 5′ end on the cap-bearing fragment while losing full-length continuity. Fraction provenance remains a sample-level association.

operations.label: Ligate 5′ adapter
operations.description: Join the added green RNA adapter to the 5′-monophosphorylated, formerly capped fragment, leaving an RNA mixture with untagged OH fragments.

The matching collection page explicitly titles this route Translation-Associated Transcript Leader Sequencing and the primary paper establishes TL-seq chemistry applied separately to polysome-gradient fractions. The component TL-seq and the cited 3′-capture subprotocol do not expand method_names; the primary paper specifically assigns the adapter-ligation capture route to TATL-seq. Correction c01 resolves the extra early RT caption without adding another RT.
